essentialIdeas: Prewar European alliances and tensions created a divided Europe before 1914.

activities.label: Explain the outbreak sequence
activities.title: Explain the outbreak sequence
activities.body: In your own words, explain how the Sarajevo assassination led to war. Keep it to a few sentences.
activities.concept: Sequence from the Sarajevo assassination to declarations of war
activities.correctAnswer: The Sarajevo assassination set off the July Crisis. Mobilization and alliance commitments widened the crisis, leading major powers to declare war.
activities.feedback: A complete answer names the trigger, the widening process, and the result. If needed, separate cause, event, and outcome more clearly.

activities.label: Fix the timeline gap
activities.title: Fix the timeline gap
activities.body: Revise your explanation using this cue: Sarajevo came first, then the July Crisis, then war declarations. Try again in one or two sentences.
activities.concept: Sequence from the Sarajevo assassination to declarations of war
activities.correctAnswer: Sarajevo came first, then the July Crisis, then mobilization and alliance commitments helped produce declarations of war.
activities.feedback: This check is about ordering the chain, not adding more names. A correct repair keeps the trigger, the crisis, and the war declarations in order.

activities.label: Tell the full WWI start story
activities.title: Tell the full WWI start story
activities.body: Now explain the start of World War I again from memory. Include the prewar tensions and the outbreak sequence.
activities.correctAnswer: Before 1914, Europe was divided by alliances and tensions. After the Sarajevo assassination, the July Crisis spread, and mobilization plus alliance commitments turned it into declarations of war.
activities.feedback: This answer should connect the prewar setup to the outbreak chain in one clear story. If you missed the setup, add the alliance and tension layer back in.

items.essentialIdea: Prewar European alliances and tensions divided Europe into rival alliance blocs.

check.title: Europe in rival blocs
check.prompt: How did prewar European alliances shape tensions in Europe?
check.referenceAnswer: They divided Europe into rival alliance blocs, so a conflict in one area could quickly draw in other powers.
check.feedback: The key relationship is rivalry between blocs, not a single alliance or isolated dispute.

items.essentialIdea: The Sarajevo assassination triggered the chain of events leading to declarations of war.

check.title: Sarajevo and war outbreak
check.prompt: What was the significance of the Sarajevo assassination in the outbreak of war?
check.referenceAnswer: It triggered the chain of events that led to declarations of war.
check.feedback: The assassination was a trigger, not the whole cause of the war.

items.essentialIdea: By 1918, the war ended after the fighting that began in 1914.

check.title: 1914 to 1918 timeline
check.prompt: What does the basic 1914 to 1918 chronology show about the war's duration?
check.referenceAnswer: It shows that the war began in 1914 and ended in 1918.
check.feedback: The point is the start and end dates, not the detailed battles in between.
